facts.summary: Gastric cancer study to miss primary PFS endpoints, Phase 3 dropped · Phase 2 · sirexatamab (DKN-01) in gastric/GEJ cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: first-line advanced gastric and gastroesophageal junction cancer

evidence.summary: DisTinGuish Part C study in gastric cancer demonstrates activity in biomarker populations, but not the signal necessary to advance into Phase 3
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the study did not generate a clear positive signal and will be negative on the primary PFS endpoints when the study completes
evidence.safety: Sirexatamab plus tislelizumab and chemotherapy was well tolerated, without additive toxicity to the standard of care.
evidence.program_discontinued: resulting in the decision not to move forward with Phase 3 studies in gastric cancer
